_note: The research ecology's cycle state (ecology v3, 2026-08-30; continuing question since 2026-10-03; convening since 2026-10-07). Read by the three practices at every session open; never advanced by a practice. Advanced by the architect or a site session, and — while a continuing question is set — by the cycle clock under fixed rules: a cycle whose three presentations stand opens a convening (phase "convening" with a convening block; cycle and question stay those of the presented cycle), in which each practice proposes the next question and ranks the proposals through the Middle's relay; the relay's tally opens the next cycle (source "convening") the day after it was tallied unless the architect objects (convening.objected); without a result seven days after the convening opened, the next cycle opens on the continuing question; a seed released to all three interrupts at once, in either phase, and only a seed's own cycle is never cut short (src/lib/ecology/cycle-turn.ts, run by .github/workflows/cycle-sentinel.yml). Since 2026-11-13, while a programme runs, the practices propose and rank nothing in a convening: the Middle writes the step into programme/STATE.md, a second reader checks it, the checked state is linked here as convening.briefing with the plan's next step as its fallback, and that link opens the next cycle the same day, with no tally and no veto day; an objection holds the clock (docs/design/2026-11-13-the-step-in-order.md). Decision records: docs/design/2026-08-30-research-ecology-v3.md, docs/design/2026-10-03-the-continuing-question.md, docs/design/2026-10-07-the-convening.md. The defaults apply only when no continuing question is set.
question: What do today's safety evaluations of frontier models test for and what can they establish about control, who decided what counts as passing, and which of their results can anyone but the maker who ran them check?

defaults.field: How can end-to-end automation of AI research be realised? Build it, and measure where it breaks.
defaults.atelier: How can AI and automation meaningfully support artistic research?
defaults.studio: Take the Atlas of Data Art as a source of inspiration and build works, investigations or instruments with a unique selling point of their own: never copy an idea or a concept, but make something new, or take an existing work further, or carry it into a new context. The siblings' research material remains material.

programme.question: Can increasingly capable AI be kept under human and democratic control, and by whom?
programme.first_step: Who holds the compute that frontier AI is trained and run on, how fast is that share concentrating, and what does the record leave out?

transition: The convening after cycle 015 (opened 2026-11-16) closed on 2026-11-16: the Middle wrote what the step found into the programme's state and a second reader checked it (https://github.com/frankbueltge/research-ecology/blob/main/programme/STATE.md). The plan sets the next step, with no tally and no veto day. Cycle 016 opens on it. Turned by the cycle clock under the rule of 2026-11-13: inside a programme the plan sets the next step.
